$comment: Project hooks. Checked in, so every agent working in this repository gets
them. What each one is for is documented in the script it runs; the short
version is that these three replace rules CLAUDE.md used to state as prose.
guard_bash.py    refuses destructive git, broad staging, emoji in a commit
message, and stops a push to main for confirmation.
fast_gate.py     lints the single file that just changed (ruff, pyflakes,
eslint against HEAD, mobile tsc). Roughly 0.1-4 seconds.
related_tests.py runs the tests belonging to the files the session touched,
on Stop. The full suites are ~2 minutes each and belong
before a commit, not after every edit.
No timeout is declared on purpose: every subprocess these scripts run
carries its own timeout, so the bound does not depend on how the harness
All three fail open. A hook that breaks must never stop somebody working.
